<!-- Source page: Mango -->

[Mango](https://mangowm.github.io/) is a lightweight, modern <a href="Wayland" class="wikilink" title="Wayland">Wayland</a> compositor based on [dwl](https://codeberg.org/dwl/dwl). Mango provides features like animations, IPC, different layouts and visual effects.

## Installation

As of August 2026, the mango module is not present by default in NixOS and <a href="Home_Manager" class="wikilink" title="Home Manager">Home Manager</a> and needs to be imported using <a href="Flakes" class="wikilink" title="Flakes">Flakes</a>.
